answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The basalt is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the voyage. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the velvet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
